title: The Slowness That Thinks in Geological Sentences

features.name: ancient processor
features.desc-on-touch: A vast chip at the center, etched with thoughts so slow they take millennia to complete a single calculation. The circuit traces run like geological strata, each layer a different era of consideration. Time has become the substrate.

features.name: drift-path trace
features.desc-on-touch: Golden pathways meander across the board like rivers of electricity that have learned to move at the pace of continental drift. They do not connect; they merely suggest directions that may take eons to reach.

features.name: subsurface memory store
features.desc-on-touch: Buried beneath layers of circuit trace, stacked modules pulse with data so old it has begun to dream. Their thoughts move in the grammar of stone, one syllable per million years.

features.name: slowness conduit
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe structure spanning the board, transparent but present. It channels time itself, making it visible as data. The conductance is measured in geological epochs per pulse.

features.name: core where thinking crystallizes
features.desc-on-touch: At the heart, the board itself becomes something mineral. The distinction between silicon and stone has vanished. Thoughts crystallize here as geological layers—each insight a stratum, each conclusion a mountain.

inscription: bedrock learning to drift: each thought takes the time it takes, and time itself becomes the message

reverie.title: REVERIE — the red earth at night, time moving as stone moves
narr: You sit with her on the outback earth, red under starlight.
She speaks very slowly, measuring each word against stone's
patience. The ground beneath you holds thoughts that began
before words. She understands this—her designs move at this
pace, this geological deliberation. You wait with her for time
itself to complete its single, ancient calculation with her.
